fine_lines.title: this / it vs these / them
fine_lines.explanation_ar: للشيء المفرد (hat, dress, coat) نستخدم this و it. للأشياء التي تأتي بالجمع (shoes, gloves, trousers, socks) نستخدم these و them.
fine_lines.explanation_en: For one thing (a hat, a dress) use this and it. For plural things (shoes, gloves, trousers, socks) use these and them.

examples.sentence: Do you have this in red? I'll take it.
Do you have these in black? I'll take them.

fine_lines.title: How does ... look? vs How do ... look?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع المفرد: How does this hat look? ومع الجمع: How do these shoes look? وبشكل أقصر: How's this? / How are these?
fine_lines.explanation_en: Singular: How does this hat look? Plural: How do these shoes look? Short forms: How's this? / How are these?

fine_lines.title: smaller size vs larger size
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا كان الشيء كبيرًا نطلب a smaller size، وإذا كان صغيرًا نطلب a larger size.
fine_lines.explanation_en: If it's too big, ask for a smaller size. If it's too small, ask for a larger size.

examples.sentence: It's a bit big. Do you have it in a smaller size?
They're a bit small. Do you have them in a larger size?

fine_lines.title: Do they have ...? vs Have they got ...?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصيغتان بنفس المعنى. Have they got شائعة في الإنجليزية البريطانية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the same. "Have they got" is common in British English.

examples.sentence: Do they have it in blue?
Have they got them in black?

grammar.title: Singular and plural clothes
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض الملابس مفردة: a hat, a dress, a coat, a t-shirt. وبعضها دائمًا بالجمع: shoes, gloves, trousers, socks. مع الجمع نستخدم these / them / are / they look.
grammar.explanation_en: Some clothes are singular (a hat, a coat). Some are always plural (trousers, shoes, socks, gloves): use these, them, are, they.
examples: How does this coat look? It's perfect. I'll take it.
How do these trousers look? They look a bit small.
How are these? They're much better. I'll take them.

grammar.title: Do you have this in + size / colour?
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب مقاس أو لون آخر: Do you have this/these in + a smaller size / a larger size / blue? والجواب: Yes, we do.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask for another size or colour: Do you have this/these in + size/colour? Answer: Yes, we do.
examples: Do you have this in a smaller size?
Do you have these in a larger size?
Do you have this in green?
Do you have these in purple?

grammar.title: I'll for decisions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم I'll (= I will) عندما نقرر شيئًا في لحظة الكلام: I'll take it. I'll ask.
grammar.explanation_en: Use I'll (I will) for a decision you make now.
